description: Create a Gmail filter for mail that arrives from now on. Actions are labels, by name or id: add a label to file it; remove INBOX to skip the inbox, UNREAD to mark it read; add STARRED or IMPORTANT. Adding TRASH or SPAM needs discard: true, since such mail is never seen. No forwarding. It does not touch mail already there: the result's filter.query is the search to give modify_labels_matching for that. Gmail has no filter update; to change one, create the new one and delete the old. Needs the gmail.settings.basic scope on the account's grant, and says so if it is missing.

account.description: Which mailbox this writes to or sends from: a label from list_accounts. Required; there is no default for writes.

add.description: Labels to add (names or ids). Create a missing one first with create_label.

discard.description: Allow add to hold TRASH or SPAM: arriving mail then goes there unseen.

from.description: Sender: an address, a domain (e.g. news.example.com), or Gmail's from: syntax.

query.description: Any Gmail search ("Has the words"), e.g. 'list:github.com OR from:notifications@github.com'.

remove.description: Labels to remove: INBOX skips the inbox, UNREAD marks read.

name: create_filter
title: Create filter
